coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Population is 'high grade (WHO Grade III or IV) glioma'; glioblastoma not named literally anywhere; coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named on the basis of D27C (grade IV glioma without IDH requirement = historical GBM), flagged uncertain for adjudication. Pembrolizumab is in both arms but is investigational in each (no SOC role), so all three main drugs are experimental_combination. Supportive drugs (folic acid, vitamin B12, dexamethasone, ibuprofen) are listed in the pemetrexed intervention description; the record's wording on ibuprofen is ambiguous (eligibility asks patients to interrupt NSAIDs around pemetrexed). Tumour PK yes based on CSF drug-level collection; a secondary outcome also measures 'Immunotherapeutic drug levels in specimens'. Target engagement unclear: pre/post tumour gene-signature comparison and blood/CSF biomarkers are planned but not tied to a specific candidate target.
